svg.title: Every subgroup can disagree with the total
svg.desc: A whiteboard sketch of the 1973 Berkeley admissions data drawn as six departments, each showing a blue dot for men and a green dot for women with women equal or higher in four of six, arranged along a steep red downward trend line so the aggregate reads men 44.5 percent against women 30.4 percent; three small causal diagrams distinguishing a confounder, a collider and a mediator with what to control for written under each; two scatter plots where a single outlier takes the Pearson correlation from 0.895 to 0.087 while Spearman stays at 0.885; and a bar showing 257 of 4,950 pairs of pure noise variables reaching p below 0.05.
svg.text: Every subgroup can disagree with the total
Berkeley 1973: every department, and all of them
share of applicants who are women ->
within departments: women equal or better in 4 of 6
this line is real AND misleading
corr(department admit rate, share of women applicants) = -0.786
women applied to the hard departments. That is the whole paradox.
and the third variable, three ways
search 4,950 things at alpha = 0.05 and you WILL find 250.
it, segment it, and name the third
